description: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) on the y-axis against the activated parameters ratio (%) on the x-axis, comparing four different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)”, spans from 25% to 100% in a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 25%. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL”, ranges from 11.5 to 14.0, also on a linear scale, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays four distinct lines: the “Transformer” is shown as a dashed red line with circular markers, remaining nearly constant at approximately 11.75 PPL across the entire x-axis range; the “Only MoHD FFN” is a gray dashed line with square markers, starting at approximately 11.6 PPL at 100% and declining to about 11.4 PPL at 25%; the “Only MoHD ATTN” is a solid dark blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 11.6 PPL at 100% and rising sharply to about 14.0 PPL at 25%; and the “MoHD ATTN + MLP” is a solid cyan line with cross markers, starting at approximately 11.6 PPL at 100% and increasing to about 13.0 PPL at 25%.
